Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text.en: Are you going into CINDER FOREST?\nIt burned long ago, and the paths\ltwist like a maze. Don't get lost.
Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text.fr: Tu entres dans la FORÊT DE\nCENDRES ? Elle a brûlé il y a\llongtemps, et les chemins forment\nun labyrinthe. Ne te perds pas.

Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text.en: RATTATA may be small, but don't\nunderestimate its wicked bite.\pHave you caught one already?
Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text.fr: RATTATA est petit, mais ne\nsous-estime pas sa morsure\lvicieuse.\pEn as-tu déjà capturé un ?
